shared_elements: single dominant anthropomorphic figure filling a tall rectangular field
shallow incised/low-relief carving on brownish stone
circular or disc-shaped motif on the figure's torso area
rows of small repeated incised marks (hatching/fringe-like detail)
curved band across the body suggesting a belt or garment edge
justification: Both are brown stone carvings dominated by one large anthropomorphic body bearing incised circular/disc motifs and a curving belt-like band across the torso, and both are shown mounted in a gallery. But A is a flat, crisply drawn wall panel with a figure in strict profile, feathered wings and fine linear detail, while B is a massive, heavily eroded three-dimensional block with a frontal, blocky head and coarse, barely legible incisions — the manner of carving and the viewing format are quite different.
